environment.maturity: reviewed unsigned local staging; not pinned release CI

gradle.firstPartyMaterialization: Directly from the isolated verified file repository; no first-party HTTP or cache-only/offline claim.

centralResponseCache.boundary: Per-run anonymous Central-only verified HTTP response reuse; no imported Maven cache. Response-object counts alone do not prove completed delivery or Maven consumption.

maven.firstPartyMaterialization: Retrieved over the controlled loopback HTTP repository into absent per-case Maven caches; consumed hashes and repository origin markers verified.

limitations: Resolver policy and first-party materialization evidence only. No SQL/MySQL, runtime collision, complete release, public 0.2 publication or external adoption claim.
Consumer-owned capability and Enforcer policies are explicitly configured by these fixtures.
Nine staged JAR/POM/module payloads are bound as inputs; Maven consumes JAR/POM metadata, not Gradle .module metadata.
A later release payload set must be compared before reusing this candidate evidence. Raw local files are retained privately, not represented as public downloads.
